vintage: TMJA national road network 2024 reference year; section measurement years vary

lenses.name: Road traffic
lenses.description: Length-weighted average annual daily traffic on national-road sections, sampled into map hexes. Coverage is the national road network only; departmental and municipal roads are excluded. Section measurement years can precede the 2024 reference year.

lenses.name: Heavy vehicle share
lenses.description: Heavy vehicles as a traffic-weighted share of annual average daily vehicles on national-road sections. Coverage excludes departmental and municipal roads; the share is not total freight volume.
